title: PZ Agent Local Core RPC Request
description: One call from a local client — today the MCP executable — to the sidecar's Core RPC server. Local only: the transport is a Windows named pipe or a Unix socket, never a network address. The `protocol` const records what this build emits; a decoder accepts any peer whose major matches, because a minor bump only adds methods.

id.description: Chosen by the client and echoed back. Opaque to the server; an answer carrying a different one is refused rather than matched.

method.description: A dotted name from the closed set the router publishes.
